confirmed.summary: Different pattern-forge source jobs reuse one pipeline, leaving the second source unbound.

reproduction.method: Invoked the real createPatternForgeJob command twice using different themes, identical pipeline answers, and no idempotencyKey, with the scheduler stopped.

evidence: E:/EcomGen/desktop/packages/backend/src/commands/patterns.ts:163 includes theme in the source-job fingerprint, so the requests create distinct jobs. Line 169 supplies null patternId and patternHash for both pipelines.
E:/EcomGen/desktop/packages/backend/src/commands/patternPipelines.ts:25 omits sourceJobId from the fingerprint. Lines 26–28 return the reusable pipeline before line 47 can bind the second source.
E:/EcomGen/desktop/packages/core/src/repositories/patternPipelineRepository.ts:87 reuses matching QUEUED, RUNNING, and AWAITING_INPUT pipelines without checking source identity.
E:/EcomGen/desktop/packages/backend/src/execution/index.ts:96 returns without pipeline progression when the completed source has no associated step.
refutation_checks: Source-job deduplication does not protect different themes.
The unique job-to-step association does not help because the second binding is never attempted.
The real command dispatcher and pipeline-answer validation accepted both requests.

boundaries: No production repository files were edited.

confirmed.summary: 失败槽位补偿未复用已有完整回执，而是创建新任务并再次发送生图请求。
evidence: 隔离实际 Backend 复现：首次生图 POST 成功，下载返回 503；任务 FAILED，请求账本为 COMPLETED/localState=PENDING。调用 retryFailedDraftBatch 后，新任务 SUCCEEDED，生图 POST 从 1 次增加到 2 次，Idempotency-Key 随新 jobId 改变。

E:/EcomGen/desktop/packages/backend/src/execution/job-pattern-drafts.ts:258–259 使用 generationKeyFor(job.id, slotIndex)；E:/EcomGen/desktop/packages/backend/src/runtime/request-ledger.ts:40 仅在当前任务的请求记录中查找回执，新补偿任务没有继承旧证据。
E:/EcomGen/desktop/migration-discovery/INTERFACES.md:104 明确要求已有完整回执时重放，并仅续做下载或本地阶段。
guards_checked: UNKNOWN/IN_FLIGHT 屏障确实有效，但完整回执后的下载失败不属于未知结果，因此不会阻止此路径。
普通 retryJob 确实可以安全复用回执。独立对照复现中，同一任务重试后成功，累计只有 1 次生图 POST、2 次下载；但补偿按钮调用的是 retryFailedDraftBatch。
现有补偿测试只验证失败槽位选择和 UNKNOWN 拒绝，普通重试测试走同一 jobId，均不能反驳本问题。

独立流水线复现：透明起稿首次使 Pipeline/SOURCE 均 FAILED；retryJob 后 SOURCE 被标为 SUCCEEDED，并实际创建下一步骤任务，期间没有新增生图 POST。
